title: Integral derived global sections preserve uniformly bounded-below coproducts
statement: Let T be a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme [def-pc-scheme] [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme] [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], R an arbitrary commutative ring sheaf on its pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], A a commutative ring and φ:A→Γ(T,R) a scalar homomorphism. Use the ordinary module derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] with the size convention [def-weil-size-convention]. Assume these localizations are chosen and the source has K-injective resolutions [def-pur-kinjective-complex]. Let F be evaluation at the terminal object followed by scalar restriction along φ, with its canonical additive structure. Given a small family M_i with a common integer cohomological lower bound N [def-sbc-standard-tstructure-derived-category], the unbounded right derived functor RF preserves its coproduct. In particular this applies to the completed integral global sections functor [def-weil-pbc-adic-global-derived-hom]. No rational-algebra structure or constancy assumption on R is imposed.

proof.text: Use the already proved coefficient-general helper qcqs_evaluation_preservesCoproducts in the implementation of [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-module-cohomology-coproducts]. Its proof uses the affine weakly contractible hypercover and evaluation-colimit theorems; unlike that node's public direct-image theorem, this helper has no rational-algebra hypothesis. Evaluation is at a terminal pro-etale object, whose scheme is isomorphic to T and hence qcqs. Restriction of scalars along A→R(T) is both a left and a right adjoint, so exact and coproduct preserving. The proved helper rightDerivedExactCompIso gives coproduct preservation of every classical right derived functor of A-valued global sections.

The independent-universe Grothendieck theorem [prop-pur-kinjective-resolutions-exist] gives enough injectives. Choose injective representatives E_i vanishing below the common bound N, using [def-sbc-standard-tstructure-derived-category] and [lem-weil-pbc-dplus-injective-representative]. The termwise coproduct E has the same lower bound. For q>0 its terms satisfy R^qΓ(E^n)=⊕_i R^qΓ(E_i^n)=0 by step 1 and injectivity. Thus its terms are Γ-acyclic. Apply the already proved coefficient-general helpers unit_of_acyclic and uniformCoproduct in [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-bounded-below-coproducts]: they identify derived Γ of this termwise coproduct with termwise Γ and prove preservation of the coproduct of QE_i. These helpers also do not assume rational coefficients. Transport the resulting preservation instance through the chosen diagram isomorphism QE_i≅M_i.

proof_origin.place: Lemma 6.3.14(1); Stacks Tags 09A2 and 09A3; D4 representative-level formalization.

theorem proEtale_derivedGlobalSections_boundedBelow_preservesColimit
    (T : Scheme.{u}) [CompactSpace T] [QuasiSeparatedSpace T]
    (R : Sheaf (ProEt.topology T) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A]
    (φ : A →+* R.obj.obj (op (⊤_ T.ProEt)))
    [HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)]
    [HasDerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u + 1} ((sheafCompose (ProEt.topology T)
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj R))]
    [Abelian.HasKInjectiveResolutions (SheafOfModules.{u + 1}
      ((sheafCompose (ProEt.topology T)
        (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj R))]
    (I : Type (u + 1)) (M : I → DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u + 1}
      ((sheafCompose (ProEt.topology T)
        (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj R)))
    (N : ℤ) (hM : ∀ i, (M i).IsGE N) :
    letI : (SheafOfModules.evaluation.{u + 1} ((sheafCompose (ProEt.topology T)
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj R)
        (op (⊤_ T.ProEt))).Additive := ⟨by intros; rfl⟩
    PreservesColimit (Discrete.functor M)
      ((SheafOfModules.evaluation.{u + 1} ((sheafCompose (ProEt.topology T)
        (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj R) (op (⊤_ T.ProEt)) ⋙
          ModuleCat.restrictScalars φ).rightDerivedFunctor)
